data.name: Rushcraft
data.detailed_description:
Rushcraft is a fast-paced fantasy adventure where time is your most precious resource.

You are a wandering mage who stumbles upon a forgotten castle at the edge of a mysterious forest. Inside its ruined halls lie abandoned crafting stations, old alchemical devices, and the promise of powerful magical creations.

Each Day Is a Race Against the Clock

Venture into the forest to gather rare resources, uncover hidden paths, and collect valuable loot. Then return to the castle to craft magical items, tools, and gadgets using the equipment you’ve restored. Finally, sell your creations to fund your next expedition and push deeper into the unknown.

Time is limited. Every decision matters.

You only have a short window to explore, and an equally tight schedule to craft. Spend too long searching the forest, and you may miss your chance to refine your loot. Focus too much on crafting, and the forest’s secrets may slip through your fingers. Master the balance, and you may uncover the mysteries hidden within both the castle walls and the forest beyond.

Features

  • ⏱️ Fast-paced, time-based gameplay — every second counts

  • 🌲 Explore a mysterious forest filled with secrets, loot, and risk

  • 🧪 Restore and use crafting stations to create magical items

  • 🏰 Rebuild a forgotten castle as your central hub

  • ⚖️ Strategic time management between gathering, crafting, and selling

  • ✨ Cozy fantasy atmosphere with high-stakes decision making

Plan carefully, move quickly, and spend your time wisely.
Only the most efficient mages will unlock the forest’s deepest secrets.

data.short_description: Rushcraft is a fast‑paced forest adventure where every second matters. Dash through paths, collect rare resources, and craft tools and gadgets before the clock runs out. The deeper you go, the greater the rewards — but only if you can beat the ticking timer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD R9 270 (2GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 @ 3.4 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 @ 3.2 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X (4GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems

mac_requirements.minimum:
